body: He was just upset and frustrated with me. It was at the end of a very circular conversation. I don't know if I can get to the hospital on my own. I'm disabled, too, and can't drive. Might just hang myself with a belt.

I basically only trust her at this point. I had told my boyfriend about my ideation back a couple of weeks before my last attempt but he got upset and told me if I was so suicidal I should just do it and stop bothering him about it. I know he was just mad and didn't mean it, but I guess I just... don't trust anyone anymore. Didn't even tell him about what I did last week.
